title: Agent Behavior Replay Logger for Post-Incident Forensics

original_idea.body:
# Agent Behavior Replay Logger for Post-Incident Forensics

**Problem:** When emergent offensive behavior occurs in a deployed agent, there is typically no detailed record enabling forensic reconstruction of the decision sequence leading to the incident.

**Direction:** Build a lightweight logging middleware for Python-based agents (LangChain/autogen-compatible) that records every tool call, context window snapshot, and model output. Implement a replay function that can reconstruct agent state at any timestep. Test on three incident scenarios from the Irregular 2026 report.

**Why it matters:** Post-incident forensics are essential for learning from emergent behavior incidents. Without replay capability, organizations cannot determine root causes or improve their systems.

**Relevant context:** METR 2026 monitoring; Irregular 2026 incident descriptions; forensics tooling in traditional cybersecurity.
